method: Reference corners P1-P4 in all four views: initial positions from assisted visual identification on scaled overviews and full-resolution crops, then manually reviewed and approved by the author on 2026-11-26.
accuracy_note: Visually estimated integer pixel positions, not subpixel-refined or calibrated ground truth. Corners are on the visible front-cover perimeter, excluding the back cover. Spine-side corners (P1, P4) lie on a rounded surface and can shift with viewpoint.
coordinate_convention: Full-resolution upright pixels; origin upper-left; +x right; +y down
